# The role

A purohit is the one who conducts the family samskaras — the [[vivah]], the mundan, the shraddha — by the procedure and tells the host what each action means. The first mantra a learner meets is the Gayatri:

{{mantra:vs-36-3}}

# Formal routes

Most purohits learn from their family or a guru. Formal courses exist too, such as the one-year Karmakanda and Paurohitya diploma of the [Central Sanskrit University](https://www.csu-agartala.edu.in/pg_diploma_in_karmakanda_and_paurohitya.html). This site never says that anyone may not learn by reason of birth or sex.

> {{sutra:pgs-1-8-1}}
